metadata.notes: These are retrospective manual annotations for selected beats where the automated annotator was uncertain. The original_class reflects the model's initial prediction; corrected_class reflects expert re-interpretation. Use these to evaluate the ECG classification model and to compute the per-lead confusion matrix in the evaluation rubric.
